items.title: 《CNN》：盧比歐正更認真考慮角逐 2028年美國總統
items.title_en: CNN: Rubio Seriously Considering a Run for the 2028 U.S. Presidency
paras: 《CNN》週四(19日)報導，美國國務卿盧比歐(Marco Rubio)正更認真考慮角逐2028年總統大選。共和黨期中選舉慘敗後，部分金主、國會議員與政治操盤手積極勸進，希望他能帶領共和黨擴大支持基礎。不過，親近人士透露，盧比歐尚未做出最終決定，打算觀察未來幾個月的選情變化，川普是否支持也將是重要考量。
多名知情人士指出，盧比歐對參選的態度已出現微妙變化。他去年曾強調，若副總統范斯(JD Vance)決定參選，自己會予以支持，但最近已不再重申這項承諾。
兩名熟悉相關談話的消息人士表示，現年55歲的盧比歐，私下對卸任國務卿後的安排也變得更加模糊。這與川普本屆任期初期的態度明顯不同，當時他曾向盟友表明無意參選，希望轉往民間企業，尋求待遇優渥的工作。
與川普關係密切的前共和黨籍眾議院議長金瑞契(Newt Gingrich)表示：「盧比歐是我從大家口中最常聽到的名字。令我印象深刻的是，甚至在選舉之前，就已經有這麼多人說，他們真的希望他出馬。」
共和黨內對盧比歐的期待升高，正值范斯的政治前景受到更多質疑。
期中選舉後，范斯試圖與伊朗戰爭拉開距離，並在社群平台X發表長文，直言「我們敗選的原因就是戰爭」，引發部分川普盟友不滿，認為此舉形同背叛，也再次質疑他的政治判斷。
一些盧比歐支持者預期，范斯這番敗選檢討可能持續發酵，甚至引發他與川普的正面衝突。
對於長期不認同范斯外交立場，以及他對以色列抱持懷疑態度的共和黨人士而言，這也成為推動盧比歐出馬的新契機。
不過，盧比歐仍拒絕公開討論2028年選舉。他上週在巴黎出席七大工業國集團(G7)外長會議期間，面對CNN提問時表示，自己「不會以任何形式討論這件事」。
他說：「我有這個選擇，我可以做出選擇。有些事情，我就是不會談。」
熟悉相關對話的人士指出，盧比歐在川普政府內部也格外謹慎，避免談論即將到來的總統選戰，尤其注意自己在多人場合的發言。
美國國務院與范斯的代表均拒絕對這篇報導置評。
儘管如此，盧比歐上週在聯邦主義者學會大會上的演說，仍被部分身邊人士視為觀察其潛在競選主張的窗口。
他在女兒介紹後登台，闡述向外拓展美國價值與力量的願景，形容美國是「一個懷抱不可抑制雄心的國家，而這份雄心，從一開始就遠遠超越國界」。
一名熟悉盧比歐私下考量的川普顧問表示：「他熱愛自己的工作，熱愛擔任國務卿，也明白眼前有一些非常重要的事情要處理。但我也認為，他內心有一部分始終想當總統。」
盧比歐是否參選，涉及未來兩年的政治布局與施政機會。
知情人士指出，身為古巴移民之子，他尤其希望促成古巴持久的政治變革，目前正主導旨在促使古巴共產政權垮台的施壓行動。部分人士認為，接下來兩年可能是推進這項工作的機會窗口，而古巴裔支持者也期待他交出成果。
繼續留在政府，有助於盧比歐累積政績，卻也意味著必須承擔更多危機與政策風險。本週一連串網路服務中斷事件引發疑慮，部分官員公開批評政府缺乏透明度後，他在馬尼拉臨時召開記者會，試圖安撫外界。
這次應對強化了他善於溝通、在國安事務上值得信賴的形象，但也凸顯，留在政府的時間愈長，就愈可能捲入新的危機。范斯則於週三(18日)突然取消出席《紐約時報》DealBook峰會，理由是必須留在白宮，參與處理接連發生的科技問題。
外交政策更是盧比歐無法迴避的考驗。他一直試圖避免成為川普多項對外衝突的主要代表人物，包括尋找結束伊朗戰爭的途徑，以及推動俄烏戰爭落幕。川普曾在2024年競選期間承諾迅速終結俄烏戰事，但戰爭至今仍持續。
然而，盧比歐始終支持川普對伊朗發動攻擊。隨著反戰聲浪升高，他的外交立場可能同時與MAGA陣營核心的孤立主義支持者，以及受到戰爭經濟衝擊而疏遠共和黨的獨立選民產生落差。
一名前政府官員表示：「無論誰參選，都必須承擔這個政府所做的一切，或與其中部分政策切割，而這將使他們與川普的關係陷入難題。」
川普如何處理接班布局，也將左右盧比歐的決定。
許多盟友認為，盧比歐可能只有在獲得川普背書，並由川普實質排除主要競爭者的情況下，才會投入選戰。
過去幾個月，川普曾詢問盟友支持范斯還是盧比歐，也公開表達希望兩人搭檔參選。不過，期中選舉過後，他已釋出訊號，可能不會立即指定接班人，而是等到初選較後階段才表態支持。
共和黨內其他潛在人選也開始浮上檯面，包括德州聯邦參議員克魯茲(Ted Cruz)、佛羅里達州州長迪尚特(Ron DeSantis)，以及仍受川普欣賞的阿肯色州州長桑德斯(Sarah Huckabee Sanders)。桑德斯週日接受CNN訪問時，並未排除參選可能。
前白宮新聞秘書李威特(Karoline Leavitt)週二接受《福斯新聞》訪問時也表示，即使范斯參選，也不代表其他人會退出競爭。
她說：「無論副總統是否參選，我相信都會有非常多共和黨候選人投入，而我認為這對共和黨是一件非常好的事。」
儘管競爭局勢越來越開放，許多共和黨人士仍認為范斯在黨內提名戰占有優勢。
他過去幾個月一直被視為川普接班人，已著手建立金主網路，並鞏固部分MAGA選民支持。他長期反對對外戰爭，主張較少干預海外事務的「美國優先」路線，也藉由強調國內經濟問題，爭取年輕共和黨選民。
不過，盧比歐的支持者與部分富有金主認為，他更有機會在凝聚MAGA基本盤的同時，將共和黨的支持聯盟拓展至其他選民群體。
金瑞契表示：「他能以正面的方式傳達相同的核心訊息。人們就是覺得他更成熟、人格特質更全面，也能接觸更廣泛的選民。」
那名川普顧問則指出，盧比歐明白，眼前施政表現將決定未來的政治機會。
「他知道，如果沒有把這份工作做好，就沒有機會當總統。他現在看起來如此出色，其中一個原因，就是他看起來像是一個正在世界各地維護美國利益的人。」
paras_en: CNN reported on Thursday (the 19th) that U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is seriously weighing a bid for the 2028 presidential election. After the Republican Party’s crushing loss in the midterms, some donors, members of Congress and political operatives have been urging him to run, hoping he can broaden the party’s base. However, close sources say Rubio has not made a final decision and plans to watch how the race evolves over the next few months, with Trump’s support being a key factor.

Several insiders note that Rubio’s stance on running has subtly shifted. He emphasized last year that he would back JD Vance if the former vice‑presidential candidate entered the race, but he has not reiterated that pledge recently.

Two sources familiar with the conversations say the 55‑year‑old Rubio is now vague about his post‑secretary plans. This contrasts sharply with his attitude early in Trump’s current term, when he told allies he had no intention of running and wanted to move into the private sector for a lucrative job.

Newt Gingrich, the former Republican Speaker closely aligned with Trump, said, “Rubio is the name I hear most often. What strikes me is that even before the election, so many people were already saying they really want him to run.”
Expectations for Rubio within the GOP are rising as Vance’s political prospects face increasing doubt.

After the midterms, Vance tried to distance himself from the Iran war and posted a long essay on X saying, “The reason we lost is the war,” sparking anger among some Trump allies who saw it as a betrayal and questioned his judgment again.
Some Rubio supporters anticipate that Vance’s post‑mortem could keep simmering and even lead to a direct clash with Trump.
For Republicans who have long disagreed with Vance’s foreign stance and his skeptical view of Israel, this creates a new opening to push Rubio forward.
Nevertheless, Rubio still refuses to discuss the 2028 race publicly. While attending the G7 foreign ministers’ meeting in Paris last week, he told CNN he “will not discuss this in any form.”
He added, “I have the choice, I can make a choice. Some things I just won’t talk about.”

People familiar with the dialogue say Rubio is especially cautious within the Trump administration, avoiding any talk of the upcoming presidential contest and watching his remarks in multi‑person settings closely.
Both the State Department and Vance’s representatives declined to comment on the report.
Despite that, Rubio’s speech at the Federalist Society conference last week was seen by some close to him as a window into his potential campaign platform.

Introduced by his daughter, he spoke about expanding American values and power abroad, describing the United States as “a nation with an unstoppable ambition, and that ambition has from the start far exceeded borders.”

A Trump adviser who knows Rubio’s private calculations said, “He loves his job, loves being secretary of state, and knows there are very important things to handle now. But I also think part of him always wants to be president.”
Rubio’s decision to run ties into the political layout and policy opportunities over the next two years.

Insiders note that as the son of Cuban immigrants, he is especially eager to foster lasting political change in Cuba and is currently leading pressure efforts aimed at toppling the Cuban communist regime. Some say the next two years could be a window to advance that work, and Cuban‑American supporters are looking for results.

Staying in government helps Rubio build a record, but also means taking on more crises and policy risks. A string of internet‑service outages this Monday raised concerns; after some officials publicly criticized the administration’s lack of transparency, he held an impromptu press conference in Manila to soothe critics.

That response bolstered his image as a good communicator and a trustworthy figure on national‑security issues, but also highlighted that the longer he stays in office the more likely he is to get caught up in new crises. Vance, meanwhile, abruptly canceled his appearance at the New York Times DealBook summit on Wednesday (the 18th), saying he had to stay at the White House to deal with a series of tech problems.

Foreign policy remains a test Rubio cannot avoid. He has consistently tried to stay out of being Trump’s main representative in overseas conflicts, seeking ways to end the Iran war and push for a conclusion to the Russia‑Ukraine war. Trump pledged during his 2024 campaign to end the Ukraine war quickly, but the conflict continues.

Nevertheless, Rubio has always backed Trump’s attacks on Iran. As anti‑war sentiment rises, his diplomatic stance may clash both with the isolationist core of the MAGA camp and with independent voters who have drifted from the GOP due to the war’s economic impact.
A former government official said, “Whoever runs has to own everything this administration has done, or at least part of it, which will put their relationship with Trump in a difficult spot.”
How Trump handles succession planning will also influence Rubio’s choice.
Many allies believe Rubio would only enter the race if he receives Trump’s endorsement and Trump effectively removes the main competitors.

In recent months Trump asked allies whether they backed Vance or Rubio and publicly expressed a desire for the two to run together. However, after the midterms he signaled he may not name a successor right away, preferring to wait until later in the primary season to voice support.

Other potential GOP candidates have also emerged, including Texas Senator Ted Cruz, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis, and Arkansas Governor Sarah Huckabee Sanders, who still enjoys Trump’s favor. Sanders told CNN on Sunday she has not ruled out a run.
Former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt told Fox News on Tuesday that even if Vance runs, it doesn’t mean others will drop out.
She said, “Whether the vice president runs or not, I think a lot of Republican candidates will still throw their hats in the ring, and I think that’s a very good thing for the party.”
Even as the field opens up, many Republicans still see Vance as having an advantage in the party‑wide nomination battle.

He has been viewed in recent months as Trump’s heir apparent, building a donor network and consolidating support among MAGA voters. He opposes foreign wars, promotes a “America First” approach with limited overseas intervention, and emphasizes domestic economic issues to attract younger Republican voters.
However, Rubio’s supporters and some wealthy donors believe he has a better chance of uniting the MAGA base while also expanding the GOP’s coalition to other voter groups.
Gingrich said, “He can convey the same core message in a positive way. People feel he’s more mature, his character is more well‑rounded, and he can reach a broader electorate.”
That Trump adviser added that Rubio understands that his current performance in office will determine future political opportunities.

He noted, “He knows that if he doesn’t do the job well, there’s no chance of becoming president. He looks great right now, and one reason is that he appears to be someone protecting American interests around the world.”

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉沙國原油出口月增21%、美國庫存暴增340萬桶 油價陷多空拉鋸 持平作收
items.title_en: <Energy After-Hours> Saudi Crude Exports Up 21% MoM, US Inventories Surge 3.4 Million Barrels; Oil Prices Stuck in Tug‑of‑War, Close Flat
paras: 國際油價周四 (19日) 收盤幾乎持平，荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲及中東戰事持續，支撐市場對供應中斷的擔憂，但美國原油庫存意外增加、沙烏地阿拉伯出口回升，以及全球供給過剩預期，抵銷地緣政治風險帶來的漲幅。
布蘭特原油 (Brent) 期貨上漲3美分，漲幅0.03%，收在每桶91.98美元；美國西德州中級原油 (WTI) 期貨下跌5美分，跌幅0.06%，收在每桶83.21美元，創8月26日以來最低收盤價。
伊朗海軍周四透過國營媒體表示，有兩艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽遭海軍水雷擊中並發生爆炸，但《路透社》無法獨立核實這項說法。與伊朗結盟的葉門胡塞武裝也向沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德發射飛彈。
沙烏地阿拉伯民防部門表示，攻擊造成利雅德最高的摩天大樓多個樓層及附近建築受損，但沒有傳出人員傷亡。該大樓為沙烏地主權財富基金總部所在地。此前兩名獲悉沙國計畫的西方官員透露，沙烏地阿拉伯正為與胡塞武裝的戰事延續至明年做準備。
中東衝突對能源供應的衝擊仍然龐大。國際能源總署 (IEA) 周四指出，這場衝突已累計造成波斯灣地區約28億桶原油及600億立方公尺天然氣供應損失。
不過，IEA也警告，若各國政府因應戰事加速電氣化、能源效率改善及燃料轉換措施，到2035年全球石油需求可能因此減少逾4%，顯示能源供應危機也可能加速長期石油需求結構轉變。
瑞銀 (UBS Group) 分析師Giovanni Staunovo表示，伊朗攻擊行動增加，正對中東出口造成壓力，但中國同步提高原油進口，使海上運輸中的原油數量減少，進一步收緊市場供應。
另一方面，俄羅斯石油供應也面臨新的不確定性。烏克蘭持續加強對俄羅斯煉油廠及能源出口設施的攻擊，《路透社》周三引述業界消息指出，自10月底以來，烏克蘭無人機攻擊已使俄羅斯煉油廠合計原油加工量減少45%。
俄羅斯總統普丁周四表示，在烏克蘭本周第三度攻擊連接俄羅斯與克里米亞的橋樑後，莫斯科將採取強硬報復措施，並放棄暫停攻擊彼此能源產業及航運設施的構想。
儘管中東與俄羅斯能源供應風險持續升高，市場對全球原油供給過剩的憂慮仍限制油價上行空間。
根據聯合組織數據倡議 (JODI) 周四公布的資料，沙烏地阿拉伯9月原油出口量較8月增加近21%，達每日538萬桶，創今年2月以來最高水準，顯示中東部分原油供應正逐步恢復。
美國能源資訊署 (EIA) 周三公布的數據也顯示，美國原油庫存增加幅度超出市場預期。統計截至11月13日當周，美國商業原油庫存增加340萬桶，達4億1780萬桶，遠高於《路透社》調查分析師預估的增加5.8萬桶。
成品油庫存同樣增加。汽油庫存增加520萬桶至2億1590萬桶，遠高於市場預估的增加160萬桶；包括柴油及取暖油在內的餾分油庫存增加160萬桶至1億490萬桶，也高於市場預估的增加130萬桶。
此外，美國能源部長Chris Wright表示，華府正考慮提高原油及柴油對歐洲出口。自美伊戰爭爆發以來，美國已成為歐洲最大的能源供應國之一，若進一步擴大出口，可能增加國際市場供應，進一步加深市場對全球原油過剩的疑慮。
美國總統川普、俄羅斯總統普丁及中國國家主席習近平周四舉行三方會晤，三國領導人達成象徵性的和平宣言，重申核戰爭不應發生，並承諾推動能源產品供應，滿足各國需求。
川普表示，他與習近平都認為荷姆茲海峽必須維持石油運輸暢通。他另外提到，美國將在明年1月1日之後再觀察如何處理與伊朗的衝突，但並未進一步說明這個日期的具體意義。
美國參議院共和黨議員則否決一項要求川普政府結束對伊朗戰爭，或在繼續軍事行動前取得國會批准的法案，顯示美伊衝突短期內仍存在高度不確定性。
俄羅斯方面則預期，中東衝突結束後，全球原油供應可能暫時出現過剩，並帶動油價下跌。市場目前面臨的矛盾在於，一方面戰事、油輪遇襲及能源設施遭攻擊持續推升供應風險，另一方面中東出口恢復、美國庫存增加及潛在新增出口，卻不斷強化供給過剩預期。
Matador Economics首席經濟學家Tim Snyder表示，原油市場正陷入供應增加與戰爭持續造成供應中斷威脅的拉鋸，市場渴望穩定，但目前仍難以找到明確的方向。
paras_en: International oil prices closed almost unchanged on Thursday (the 19th). Attacks on tankers in the Hormuz Strait and ongoing Middle‑East fighting kept supply‑disruption worries alive, but an unexpected rise in U.S. crude inventories, a rebound in Saudi Arabian exports and expectations of global oversupply offset the geopolitical‑driven gains.
Brent futures rose 3 cents, up 0.03%, to $91.98 a barrel; U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures fell 5 cents, down 0.06%, to $83.21 a barrel, marking the lowest close since August 26.

Iran’s navy said on Thursday, via state media, that two tankers in the Hormuz Strait were hit by naval mines and exploded, a claim Reuters could not independently verify. Iran’s allied Houthi rebels in Yemen also fired missiles at Saudi Arabia’s capital, Riyadh.

Saudi civil defence reported that the attack damaged several floors of Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper and nearby buildings, but no casualties were reported. The tower houses the headquarters of the Saudi sovereign wealth fund. Earlier, two Western officials briefed on Saudi plans said the kingdom is preparing for the conflict with the Houthis to continue into next year.

The Middle‑East conflict still poses a huge shock to energy supply. The International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Thursday that the war has so far caused losses of about 2.8 billion barrels of crude oil and 60 billion cubic metres of natural gas in the Persian Gulf region.

However, the IEA warned that if governments accelerate electrification, improve energy efficiency and shift fuels in response to the war, global oil demand could fall by more than 4% by 2035, indicating that the supply crisis could also speed up a long‑term structural shift in oil demand.

UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo said Iran’s attacks are increasing pressure on Middle‑East exports, but China is simultaneously raising its crude imports, reducing the amount of oil on tankers and further tightening market supply.

On the other hand, Russian oil supply faces new uncertainty. Ukraine continues to step up attacks on Russian refineries and energy‑export infrastructure. Reuters cited industry sources on Wednesday saying that since the end of October, Ukrainian drone strikes have cut Russian refinery crude processing capacity by 45%.

Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday that after Ukraine’s third attack this week on the bridge linking Russia to Crimea, Moscow will take strong retaliatory measures and has abandoned the idea of pausing attacks on each other’s energy and shipping facilities.
Even though Middle‑East and Russian energy‑supply risks are rising, concerns about a global oil oversupply still limit upside for prices.

Data released Thursday by the Joint Organisations Data Initiative (JODI) show Saudi Arabia’s September crude exports were up nearly 21% from August, reaching 5.38 million barrels per day – the highest level since February this year – indicating a gradual recovery of Middle‑East supply.

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) data released Wednesday also showed U.S. crude inventories rose far beyond expectations. For the week ending 13 November, commercial crude stocks increased by 3.4 million barrels to 417.8 million barrels, far above Reuters analysts’ forecast of a 58,000‑barrel rise.

Finished‑product stocks also rose. Gasoline inventories climbed 5.2 million barrels to 215.9 million barrels, well above the market’s 1.6 million‑barrel estimate; distillate stocks (diesel and heating oil) rose 1.6 million barrels to 149 million barrels, also higher than the 1.3 million‑barrel forecast.

U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Washington is considering increasing crude and diesel exports to Europe. Since the start of the U.S.–Iran war, the United States has become one of Europe’s largest energy suppliers, and further export expansion could boost global supply and deepen market concerns about an oil surplus.

U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a three‑way meeting on Thursday, issuing a symbolic peace declaration, reaffirming that nuclear war must not occur and pledging to promote energy‑product supply to meet each nation’s needs.

Trump said both he and Xi believe the Hormuz Strait must remain open for oil shipments. He added that the United States will reassess how to handle the conflict with Iran after Jan. 1 2025, without elaborating on the significance of that date.

Republican senators in the U.S. Senate voted down a bill that would require the Trump administration to end the war with Iran or obtain congressional approval before further military action, underscoring the short‑term uncertainty of the U.S.–Iran clash.

Russia expects that once the Middle‑East conflict ends, global oil supply could temporarily become oversupplied, pushing prices down. The market’s paradox is that while war, tanker attacks and energy‑facility strikes raise supply‑risk concerns, the rebound in Middle‑East exports, rising U.S. inventories and potential new exports continually reinforce oversupply expectations.

Matador Economics chief economist Tim Snyder said the crude market is caught in a tug‑of‑war between increasing supply and the ongoing threat of war‑induced disruptions. The market craves stability but still lacks a clear direction.

paras:

paras_en: The Taiwan market has been sliding recently, and on the 19th it plunged another 1,768 points, marking the seventh‑largest single‑day drop on record and breaking below the 40,000‑point, 39,000‑point and yearly moving‑average thresholds. To preserve market order and stability, the Financial Supervisory Commission announced that starting today (the 20th) it will implement five new stabilisation measures, including reinstating a “conditional short‑selling ban.” If a stock falls more than 3.5% at the close, short sales cannot be placed the next trading day at a price below the previous day’s close. The daily intraday borrowing‑to‑sell limit will be cut from 3% to 1%, and the commission will encourage financial institutions to buy quality stocks on dips and to conduct share buy‑backs, aiming to restore market confidence.

In October the Taiwan market experienced extreme volatility, with the weighted index falling a cumulative 2,729 points – the worst October drop in history. Foreign investors sold a record‑high NT$948.1 billion, setting a new all‑time net‑sell benchmark. The heavy market decline, together with losses in proprietary trading and underwriting, pushed the after‑tax net profit of all securities firms down to NT$7.52 billion for October, a drop of NT$11.261 billion or 59.96% from September. Nevertheless, buoyed by strong first‑half momentum, the cumulative net profit for the first ten months of the year remained NT$208.774 billion, up NT$121.089 billion or 138.1% year‑on‑year.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC, 2330‑TW) announced on the 19th, via its subsidiary TSMC Partners, that it has purchased 6,024,096 ordinary shares of U.S. AI start‑up Anthropic at US$83 per share, for a total transaction value of US$4,999,999,968, representing roughly 0.03% of Anthropic’s equity. The price matches Anthropic’s IPO pricing and the purchase is intended as a long‑term equity investment.

On the 19th the Taiwan market’s high‑tech and financial‑sector heavyweights fell, and traditional industries weakened simultaneously, causing a sharp plunge of 1,935.21 points to 38,259.7 points. Although the National Security Fund stepped in to provide support, the session still ended down 1,768.02 points or 4.4%, the seventh‑largest point drop ever, closing at 38,426.89 points and breaking below the yearly moving average, with a turnover of NT$895.282 billion. Foreign investors withdrew NT$24.312 billion that day, selling across four categories, and the 0050 index and several active ETFs again became targets for reduction.

Sunlight Group (3711‑TW) subsidiary Taiwan FoRe Electronics held a groundbreaking ceremony for a new plant in the Renwu Industrial Park, Kaohsiung, attended by Sunlight CEO Wu Tian‑yu, Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chi‑mai, Director‑General Yang Zhi‑qing of the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Park Administration, Kaohsiung City Council Speaker Kang Yu‑cheng, and senior managers from Sunlight’s Kaohsiung facility. Following the progress of the Renwu plant project, Taiwan FoRe will invest NT$248.9 billion, with construction slated for phased completion between 2028 and 2029. The K and J sites are expected to generate combined annual revenue of about NT$117.3 billion and create roughly 3,300 jobs, expanding the “high‑end semiconductor testing services industrial park” in Renwu.
The Taiwan market continues to tumble as the Financial Supervisory Commission rolls out the conditional short‑selling ban and four other stabilisation measures starting tomorrow.

October proves to be the worst on record for the Taiwan market, with all brokerage firms seeing monthly profits shrink by nearly 60%, though they still posted a cumulative profit of NT$208.7 billion for the first ten months.
TSMC spends close to US$500 million to acquire 6.02 million Anthropic shares, representing about 0.03% ownership.
Foreign investors withdraw another NT$24.3 billion, and the 0050 index and active ETFs suffer heavy sell‑offs.
Sunlight expands into the AI era, investing NT$248.9 billion in Kaohsiung’s Renwu district to enlarge the high‑end semiconductor testing cluster.
The Tatung‑Hua‑Ying case settles for RMB 768 million, potentially recouping close to RMB 10 billion in losses.
Huaxin’s Vietnam plant aims to complete construction and install equipment within a year to meet AI‑driven demand.
Guangyu expects its 2024 operations to improve, with Q1 shipments of optical‑communication products and AI server foundry services projected to contribute over NT$10 billion.
Evergreen Steel’s order backlog exceeds 208,000 tonnes, supported by AI and semiconductor fab construction demand, bolstering steel‑structure market sentiment.
Yujing Optical is optimistic about its partnership with U.S. firm 3M, expecting added operational momentum and increased capital expenditures.
Juxiang Outlook: EPS of NT$4.78 for the first three quarters surpasses the full‑year figure of last year, and Q4 operating intensity remains high.

items.title: 想延攬黃仁勳？馬斯克直言「誰不想？」他是史上最有才華企業家之一
items.title_en: Want to Recruit Jensen Huang? Musk Says "Who Doesn't?" He’s One of the Most Talented Entrepreneurs Ever
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)再度公開力挺輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳，在被問及是否願意聘用對方時，直接回答：「那當然，誰不想？」他盛讚黃仁勳是史上最有才華的企業家兼執行長之一，但也補充，黃仁勳目前並沒有在找工作，對近期事態仍感到震驚。
馬斯克週三(18日)出席《紐約時報》DealBook峰會時，透過視訊接受訪問。他當時正隨美國總統川普訪問中國，談及黃仁勳離開輝達一事，將其比喻為芝加哥公牛隊在連勝期間，把巔峰時期的籃球巨星喬丹(Michael Jordan)踢出球隊。
「黃仁勳是我的老朋友。若要形容他對一支團隊的意義，我會說，他就像處於巔峰狀態的喬丹。」馬斯克表示，在決定讓這樣的人離開前，必須深思熟慮，「這在我看來，並不是明智的決定」，也不像是對股東有利的做法。
馬斯克強調，他對黃仁勳的支持，無論公開或私下都一致。「你不會看到我公開說一套，私底下又說另一套。」
他認為，黃仁勳的價值遠超過執行長頭銜，一個人同時承擔多個角色，從供應鏈管理、技術判斷，到維繫重要供應商與員工關係，都難以找到替代人選。
「沒有人能真正取代黃仁勳。他一個人做著好幾個人的工作。」馬斯克說，黃仁勳經常與重要供應商在南韓、台灣一起吃街頭小吃，這些關係是經過數十年累積而來，加上他對技術的深入理解，使其成為公司的關鍵人物。
馬斯克也提到，黃仁勳深受團隊愛戴，不少員工即使收到其他公司更高薪的挖角邀約，仍選擇留下，原因就是對黃仁勳個人的忠誠。
當主持人進一步詢問是否願意聘用黃仁勳時，馬斯克回答：「那當然，誰不想？他是史上最有才華的企業家兼執行長之一。誰會不想聘用黃仁勳？」
不過，他隨即補充：「顯然，黃仁勳並沒有在找工作。我想，他對這些事情仍有些震驚。」馬斯克形容，整起事件就像作家馬丁(George R. R. Martin)筆下《冰與火之歌》的劇情，觀眾投入感情的重要角色突然消失，令人錯愕。
馬斯克並表示，他不認為黃仁勳對美國不忠。但當被追問是否曾與川普討論黃仁勳的未來時，他未透露更多細節，僅表示：「我們又不是董事會成員。」
儘管馬斯克持續聲援，輝達董事會已表明無意讓黃仁勳重掌執行長。新任董事長瓊斯(Harvey Jones)宣布，公司將尋找正式接班人，並成立新委員會，加強對國家安全政策與出口管制遵循的監督。
政治層面的壓力也持續升高。美國眾議院民主黨領袖傑佛瑞斯(Hakeem Jeffries)被問及推動黃仁勳復職一事時表示，若美國頂尖科技可能流向中國共產黨，並使美國人面臨風險，「這些都是不可接受的」。
黃仁勳已同意於12月1日赴眾議院三個委員會作證，說明他與Megaspeed前高層黃樂(Alice Huang)的婚外情，以及相關國家安全疑慮。黃樂被指涉嫌從事中國間諜活動，相關指控仍待釐清。
此次發言延續馬斯克近期對黃仁勳的公開支持。先前有人在X平台詢問是否願意聘用黃仁勳，他曾回答「那會是我的榮幸」；11月13日出現要求黃仁勳復職的網路連署後，他也表態願意簽署。黃仁勳辭職後，X帳號的藍勾勾認證一度消失，馬斯克則公開承諾免費協助恢復，認證隨後重新出現。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk once again publicly backed former Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang. When asked if he would hire him, he replied straight away, "Of course, who wouldn’t?" He praised Huang as one of the most talented entrepreneurs and CEOs in history, but added that Huang is not looking for a job and remains shocked by recent events.

Musk attended the New York Times DealBook summit on Wednesday (the 18th) and took a video interview while traveling with former U.S. President Donald Trump on a visit to China. Discussing Huang’s departure from Nvidia, he likened it to the Chicago Bulls kicking Michael Jordan out of the team during their championship run.

"Jensen Huang is an old friend of mine. To describe his importance to a team, I’d say he’s like a Michael Jordan in his prime," Musk said. He argued that letting a person like that go should be carefully considered, "In my view that’s not a wise decision" and it doesn’t seem to benefit shareholders.
Musk stressed that his support for Huang is consistent whether public or private. "You won’t see me say one thing publicly and something different behind closed doors," he said.

He believes Huang’s value far exceeds the CEO title; he fills multiple roles—from supply‑chain management and technical judgment to maintaining key supplier and employee relationships—and it would be hard to find a replacement.

"No one can truly replace Jensen Huang. He does the work of several people by himself," Musk said, noting that Huang often dines on street food with major suppliers in South Korea and Taiwan, relationships built over decades, and his deep technical understanding make him indispensable.
Musk also noted that Huang is beloved by his team; many employees have turned down higher‑pay offers from other firms out of loyalty to him personally.
When the host asked again whether he would hire Huang, Musk answered, "Of course, who wouldn’t? He’s one of the most talented entrepreneurs and CEOs ever. Who wouldn’t want to hire Jensen Huang?"

He quickly added, "Obviously Jensen isn’t looking for a job. I think he’s still a bit shocked by all this." Musk likened the whole saga to a plot twist in George R. R. Martin’s Game of Thrones, where a key character suddenly disappears, leaving the audience stunned.
Musk said he does not think Huang is disloyal to the United States. When pressed about whether he discussed Huang’s future with Trump, he gave no details, replying only, "We’re not board members."

Despite Musk’s continued advocacy, Nvidia’s board has made clear it has no intention to reinstall Huang as CEO. New chairman Harvey Jones announced the company will seek a formal successor and create a new committee to tighten oversight of national‑security policy and export‑control compliance.

Political pressure is also mounting. When House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries was asked about pushing for Huang’s reinstatement, he warned that if top U.S. technology ends up in the hands of the Chinese Communist Party and puts Americans at risk, “that is unacceptable.”

Huang has agreed to testify before three House committees on Dec. 1 about his alleged affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang and related national‑security concerns. Alice Huang is accused of engaging in Chinese espionage, a charge that remains under investigation.

Musk’s remarks continue his recent public support for Huang. Earlier, when asked on X whether he would hire Huang, he replied, "It would be an honor." After a petition on Nov. 13 calling for Huang’s reinstatement, he said he would sign it. Following Huang’s resignation, his blue verification tick on X briefly disappeared, and Musk publicly pledged to help restore it, which it later did.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Gains Pause as Anthropic IPO Boosts Risk Appetite, Yen Depreciates
paras: 美元週四(19日)兌多數主要貨幣回落，近期漲勢暫歇。人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic即將掛牌，提振市場風險偏好，削弱美元買盤。不過，聯準會(Fed)官員的鷹派談話與最新會議紀錄，仍使進一步升息的預期支撐美元，美元指數維持在約19個月高點附近。
美股尾盤時段，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報103.65；歐元兌美元上漲0.2%，報1.1002美元。
美元指數本週觸及2025年4月2日以來最高水準。當時，美國總統川普宣布大規模關稅措施，引發美國資產賣壓。
美元這波漲勢始於11月10日，當時美國通膨數據高於預期，促使投資人提高對聯準會緊縮政策的押注。聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)呼籲採取更積極措施對抗通膨，而10月27日至28日的會議紀錄也顯示，決策官員愈來愈擔心，可能需要進一步緊縮政策。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師奧斯本(Shaun Osborne)表示：「美元這段時間已經漲了不少，我認為目前匯價已反映許多利多。」
他指出，美元多頭若要在短期內推升匯價，需要更強的信心或更多利多消息。他並將美元部分回落，歸因於Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)前，市場風險情緒改善。
Anthropic的IPO定價高於原先行銷區間，帶動週四那斯達克期貨上漲，也提高市場對其上市表現的期待，重新提振AI類股投資情緒。
巴克萊分析師則認為，財政刺激與強勁的AI相關資本支出，反映美國經濟具有韌性，也意味經濟產出高於潛在水準的幅度可能擴大，利率將在更長時間內維持高檔，這些因素均有利美元。
儘管近期科技股遭到拋售，美元仍獲得資金流入支撐。德意志銀行追蹤逾100檔在美國境外註冊的指數股票型基金(ETF)發現，外國投資人過去兩週大舉逢低買進美股，買進力道為今年最強，顯示流向美股的資金也是支撐美元的重要因素。
隨著風險偏好回升、避險需求降溫，日元兌美元走貶。美元兌日元上漲0.4%，報159.905日元兌1美元，中止連續四個交易日下跌。
分析師指出，若AI相關資產再度遭到拋售，避險買盤與資金匯回日本可能支撐日元，但日元兌其他貨幣的升勢，可能比兌美元更為明顯。
澳幣兌美元則大致持平。澳洲10月就業人數連續第二個月減少，失業率升至五年高點，強化市場對當地利率可能已觸頂的看法。
三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman表示，市場大幅上調對聯準會升息的預期，正對大宗商品價格及相關貨幣形成壓力。
瑞銀考量澳洲通膨仍高，以及勞動與房市情況惡化，將澳洲央行首次降息時間預測，由明年11月提前至8月，並將預估降息次數由兩次增加至三次。

加密貨幣方面，受風險偏好改善帶動，比特幣上漲2.5%，報63,870美元，脫離上週日觸及的四個月低點62,026美元。

paras_en: The dollar fell against most major currencies on Thursday (the 19th), pausing its recent rally. The upcoming IPO of AI company Anthropic lifted market risk appetite and weakened dollar buying pressure. However, hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials and the latest meeting minutes still support expectations of further rate hikes, keeping the dollar index near a 19‑month high.
In the late‑day US equity session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 103.65, while the euro rose 0.2% to $1.1002.
The dollar index this week reached its highest level since April 2, 2025, when President Trump announced large‑scale tariff measures that triggered selling pressure on US assets.

The current dollar rally began on November 10, when US inflation data came in above expectations, prompting investors to increase bets on tighter Fed policy. Fed Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action against inflation, and the minutes from the Oct. 27‑28 meeting showed policymakers growing increasingly concerned that further tightening may be needed.

Shaun Osborne, chief FX strategist at Canada’s BMO Capital Markets, said: “The dollar has already risen a lot in recent weeks, and I think the current exchange rates already reflect much of the upside.”

He added that for dollar bulls to push rates higher in the short term they would need stronger conviction or more positive news, and he attributed the dollar’s partial pullback to improved market risk sentiment ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.
Anthropic’s IPO was priced above its initial marketing range, lifting Nasdaq futures on Thursday and raising expectations for its market debut, which revived sentiment toward AI‑related stocks.

Barclays analysts argue that fiscal stimulus and robust AI‑related capital spending show the US economy is resilient, suggesting output may be running above potential for longer, keeping rates high – a backdrop that benefits the dollar.

Despite recent tech‑stock sell‑offs, the dollar continued to attract inflows. Deutsche Bank, tracking over 100 offshore‑registered ETFs, found foreign investors bought US equities in large volumes over the past two weeks – the strongest buying this year – indicating that capital flowing into US stocks also underpins the dollar.
With risk appetite recovering and hedging demand easing, the yen weakened against the dollar. The USD/JPY rose 0.4% to 159.905 yen per dollar, ending a four‑day decline.

Analysts note that if AI‑related assets face another sell‑off, safe‑haven buying and capital returning to Japan could support the yen, but the yen’s gains against other currencies may be more pronounced than against the dollar.

The Australian dollar was roughly flat versus the US dollar. October employment in Australia fell for the second consecutive month, pushing the unemployment rate to a five‑year high and reinforcing market views that local rates may have peaked.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said the market’s sharp upgrade of expectations for Fed rate hikes is putting pressure on commodity prices and related currencies.

UBS, considering still‑elevated Australian inflation and worsening labour and housing conditions, moved its forecast for the Reserve Bank of Australia’s first rate cut from November next year to August and increased the expected number of cuts from two to three.

The pound rose 0.1% to $1.3162, but the GBP/EUR slipped from a 20‑month peak. Investors remain bullish on UK rate prospects while staying cautious about the potential drag on the euro from several major European elections slated for 2027.
In crypto, improved risk appetite lifted Bitcoin 2.5% to $63,870, pulling it out of the four‑month low of $62,026 hit last Sunday.

items.title: 工廠搬出中國就能去中化？北京靠海外園區延伸製造版圖
items.title_en: Can factories leaving China escape de‑industrialisation? Beijing extends its manufacturing map through overseas parks
paras: 美歐試圖透過關稅與供應鏈調整，降低對中國製造業的依賴，北京支持的海外工業園區卻正協助中企在其他國家落地生根。從摩洛哥的電池材料，到印尼的鎳加工與墨西哥的汽車零組件，中國企業利用當地勞動力、基礎建設與貿易條件，把製造版圖延伸至全球，也讓美歐降低對中國產業依賴的目標面臨新挑戰。
這些產品的產地雖然移往海外，背後的機器設備、工程師與供應商，仍可能來自中國。「中國企業製造、海外生產」，正成為全球供應鏈重組的重要趨勢。

摩洛哥成歐美跳板 中企打造海外製造聚落

位於摩洛哥港市丹吉爾南方的「穆罕默德六世丹吉爾科技城」，正逐漸從荒地變成工業聚落。園區預計容納約200家企業，主要來自中國，鄰近大型港口丹吉爾地中海港，隔著直布羅陀海峽便是歐洲市場。
進駐企業包括森麒麟輪胎(002984-CN)、電池材料商貝特瑞(920185-CN)與海亮集團。森麒麟新廠目標每年生產1,200萬條輪胎；貝特瑞正興建兩座工廠，規劃每年生產11萬噸電池材料；海亮則計畫製造數千噸各式銅材。
這項計畫在摩洛哥國王2016年訪問中國期間宣布，歷經近十年推進。根據美國外交關係協會(CFR)，全球至少有145座這類獲中國資金支持的海外園區，另有數十座正在規劃。
對中企而言，海外設廠有多重誘因：中國國內競爭激烈，其他國家可能提供較低成本，也能讓生產更接近原料與客戶。美歐對中國製商品加徵關稅，以及海關加強查核經第三國轉運規避關稅的行為，也提高了企業直接在海外生產的吸引力。

工廠搬家供應鏈跟進 美歐降低依賴更棘手

中國企業海外擴張始於2000年代初期，2013年習近平提出「一帶一路」後，隨著港口、公路、電廠與工業區建設加速，海外製造布局進一步擴大。美中貿易關係惡化，又為這股趨勢增添推力。
工業園區可協助企業處理土地、水電、通關與物流，降低從零開始設廠的難度。大型製造商落地後，供應商也跟進投資，讓零組件與服務逐漸形成聚落。
柬埔寨西哈努克港經濟特區約200家企業中，約80%來自中國。當地中資輪胎廠表示，正推動在地採購，並鼓勵供應商設廠，以帶動相關產業發展。
類似模式也出現在其他地區。墨西哥蒙特雷附近的華富山工業園，距美國邊境約三小時車程，中企在此生產家具、家電、水泵與汽車零組件；印尼莫羅瓦利工業園有近10萬人從事鎳加工、不鏽鋼與電動車電池材料生產；衣索比亞首都附近的園區，則有逾100家中企雇用超過2萬名員工。
這些布局使美歐的供應鏈調整更加複雜：企業可以在匈牙利、馬來西亞或衣索比亞生產，雇用當地員工、採購附近原料，卻仍依賴中國設備、技術人員與供應商。生產地的改變，未必同步降低對中國產業網絡的依賴。

電池材料受歡迎 整車設廠仍有政治界線

摩洛哥的優勢，在於成本、港口與市場通路。它是非洲唯一同時與歐盟、美國簽有貿易協定的國家，讓企業有機會以此為基地，拓展歐洲與非洲市場。
中企的布局也逐漸超出工業園區。國軒高科(002074-CN)正於摩洛哥大西洋沿岸興建電池廠，計畫未來十年內，達到每年供應最多140萬輛電動車所需電池的產能，銷往歐洲、非洲與中東，並預計創造約8,000個工作機會。公司表示，中國供應商也將在附近設廠生產零組件。
在巴西，比亞迪(BYDDY-US)(01211-HK)則利用福特(F-US)位於巴伊亞州的舊廠，生產電動車與油電混合車；巴西已成為比亞迪最大的海外市場。
然而，地主國也必須拿捏產業利益與政治關係。摩洛哥希望中國電池與材料業者，能強化當地以雷諾(RNLSY-US)、Stellantis(STLA-US)及其供應商為核心、發展逾二十年的汽車產業。但政府也擔心，中資工廠大量進駐可能引發歐洲不安。
摩洛哥工商部長Ryad Mezzour表示，政府歡迎中國電池與材料生產商，對中國整車廠則更加謹慎，以免與當地生產的歐洲品牌汽車直接競爭。
不過，若中國車廠開始在歐盟境內設廠，摩洛哥的立場也可能改變。他表示，摩洛哥無法比歐洲自己更積極保護歐洲。
paras_en: U.S. and European attempts to curb reliance on Chinese manufacturing via tariffs and supply‑chain adjustments are being met by Beijing‑backed overseas industrial parks that help Chinese firms plant roots in other countries. From battery materials in Morocco to nickel processing in Indonesia and auto parts in Mexico, Chinese companies are leveraging local labour, infrastructure and trade terms to expand their manufacturing footprint globally, posing a new challenge to U.S.‑European goals of reducing dependence on China’s industry.

Although the production of these goods is shifting abroad, the machinery, engineers and suppliers behind them may still come from China. “Chinese‑made, overseas‑produced” is becoming a key trend in the reshaping of global supply chains.

Morocco as a springboard for Europe and the U.S.: Chinese firms build overseas manufacturing clusters. The “Mohammed VI Tangier Tech City” south of Tangier, Morocco, is gradually turning from wasteland into an industrial hub. The park is slated to host about 200 companies, most of them Chinese, and sits next to the large Tangier Mediterranean port, with the European market just across the Strait of Gibraltar.

Entering firms include tire maker Senqilin (002984-CN), battery‑material company Betri (920185-CN) and Hailiang Group. Senqilin’s new plant aims to produce 12 million tires a year; Betri is constructing two factories with a planned annual output of 110,000 tonnes of battery material; Hailiang plans to manufacture several thousand tonnes of various copper products.

The project was announced during the Moroccan king’s 2016 visit to China and has been advancing for nearly a decade. According to the Council on Foreign Relations, there are at least 145 overseas parks worldwide that receive Chinese financing, with dozens more under planning.

For Chinese firms, overseas factories offer multiple incentives: fierce domestic competition, lower costs abroad, and proximity to raw materials and customers. Tariffs imposed by the U.S. and Europe on Chinese goods, together with stricter customs checks on third‑country transshipment to evade duties, also make direct overseas production more attractive.

Factory relocations trigger supply‑chain follow‑on, making the U.S.‑European effort to cut reliance more difficult. Chinese overseas expansion began in the early 2000s; after President Xi’s 2013 Belt‑and‑Road Initiative accelerated port, road, power‑plant and industrial‑zone construction, the overseas manufacturing footprint grew further, a trend reinforced by worsening U.S.–China trade relations.

Industrial parks help firms handle land, utilities, customs and logistics, lowering the difficulty of building a plant from scratch. Once large manufacturers settle, suppliers follow, allowing components and services to gradually form a cluster.

In Cambodia’s Sihanouk Port Special Economic Zone, about 200 firms operate, roughly 80 % of which are Chinese. A local Chinese‑owned tire plant says it is promoting local procurement and encouraging suppliers to set up factories to spur related industry development.

Similar models appear elsewhere. Near Monterrey, Mexico, the Huafu‑Shan Industrial Park, about a three‑hour drive from the U.S. border, hosts Chinese firms producing furniture, home appliances, water pumps and auto parts; Indonesia’s Morowali Industrial Park employs nearly 100,000 people in nickel processing, stainless‑steel and EV‑battery material production; a park near Ethiopia’s capital hosts over 100 Chinese firms employing more than 20,000 workers.

These deployments complicate U.S.‑European supply‑chain adjustments: companies can produce in Hungary, Malaysia or Ethiopia, hire local staff and source nearby raw materials, yet still rely on Chinese equipment, technical personnel and suppliers. Changing the production location does not necessarily reduce dependence on China’s industrial network.

Battery materials are in high demand, but full‑vehicle manufacturing still faces political boundaries. Morocco’s advantage lies in low costs, ports and market access. It is the only African nation with trade agreements simultaneously with the EU and the United States, giving firms a base to expand into European and African markets.

Chinese firms are also moving beyond industrial parks. Guoxuan High‑Tech (002074-CN) is building a battery plant on Morocco’s Atlantic coast, aiming within ten years to supply enough batteries for up to 1.4 million electric vehicles annually, exporting to Europe, Africa and the Middle East, and creating roughly 8,000 jobs. The company says Chinese suppliers will also set up nearby component factories.
In Brazil, BYD (BYDDY‑US)(01211‑HK) is using Ford’s former plant in Bahia to produce electric and plug‑in hybrid vehicles; Brazil has become BYD’s largest overseas market.

However, host countries must balance industrial benefits with political relations. Morocco hopes Chinese battery and material firms will strengthen a domestic automotive sector that has been built over more than twenty years around Renault (RNLSY‑US), Stellantis (STLA‑US) and their suppliers. The government also worries that a massive influx of Chinese factories could unsettle Europe.

Moroccan Commerce Minister Ryad Mezzour said the government welcomes Chinese battery and material producers but is more cautious about whole‑vehicle manufacturers to avoid direct competition with locally produced European‑brand cars.
Nevertheless, if Chinese automakers start building plants within the EU, Morocco’s stance could shift. He noted that Morocco cannot protect Europe more aggressively than Europe itself.

items.title: Sandisk拆股倒數！1股變8股 專家：別把拆股當買進理由
items.title_en: SanDisk Stock Split Countdown! 1 Share Becomes 8 – Experts Warn Not to Use Split as a Buying Reason
paras: 據《MarketWatch》報導，記憶體業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)預定周四(19日)收盤後進行「1拆8」股票分割，投資人每持有1股，拆股後將變成8股。不過，股數增加並不會讓持股總價值隨之提高，專家提醒，拆股也不應成為買進股票的主要理由。
Sandisk於10月宣布拆股計畫，表示自2025年2月從威騰電子(WDC-US)分拆以來，股價已大幅上漲，希望藉此提高投資人參與的便利性。
以周三收盤價776美元試算，拆股後每股理論價格約為97美元，原本持有的1股則變成8股；若不考慮市場價格波動，持股總價值仍為776美元。
根據道瓊市場數據，Sandisk股價自分拆以來累計上漲1,495%，今年夏季高點時，累計漲幅更一度達到4,704%。
Sandisk主要設計與製造NAND快閃記憶體，這類記憶體不需持續供電，也能保存資料，廣泛用於手機、資料中心與其他硬體，需求隨AI發展而增加。
盈透證券(IBKR-US)首席策略師Steve Sosnick表示，企業在股價大漲後宣布拆股並不罕見。雖然Sandisk在10月底才公布計畫，但管理層可能更早便開始規劃，當時股價正從驚人的高點回落。
他認為，管理層可能希望在股價走低之際，藉由拆股增加吸引力，同時傳達公司表現強勁、足以支持拆股的訊息，並讓投資人感覺股票更容易負擔。
降低每股價格是企業宣布拆股時的常見理由，但隨著券商提供可買進不足一股的交易服務，高股價對投資人的限制已經減輕。
Sosnick指出，拆股對選擇權交易者可能有部分好處，包括改善流動性。標準股票選擇權契約通常代表100股，拆股後較低的每股價格，有助降低新契約所對應股票部位的金額，讓資金較少的投資人更容易參與。不過，對一般股票持有人而言，拆股並未改變公司的實質價值。
JD Group Holdings執行長John Dunfee也表示，拆股可能吸引更多散戶關注，卻不能單獨構成投資理由。投資人應關注公司未來一至兩年的獲利能力，避免把拆股後較低的每股價格，誤認為估值變便宜。
他強調，真正的投資機會在於比市場更早看懂獲利前景，而非計算手上多了多少股。當拆股熱潮消退，基本面與獲利終究會重新主導股價。
paras_en: According to MarketWatch, memory‑chip maker SanDisk (SNDK‑US) plans to execute a 1‑for‑8 stock split after the market closes on Thursday (the 19th). Investors will receive eight shares for each share they currently hold, but the increase in share count does not raise the total value of their holdings, and experts caution that a split should not be a primary reason to buy the stock.

SanDisk announced the split plan in October, noting that since its spin‑off from Western Digital (WDC‑US) in February 2025 the share price has risen sharply, and the company hopes the split will make participation easier for investors.

Using the Wednesday closing price of $776 as a basis, the theoretical post‑split price per share would be about $97, turning one pre‑split share into eight shares; ignoring market fluctuations, the total holding value remains $776.
Dow Jones market data shows that SanDisk’s stock has risen a cumulative 1,495% since the spin‑off, and during the summer peak this cumulative gain briefly reached 4,704%.

SanDisk primarily designs and manufactures NAND flash memory, which retains data without power and is widely used in phones, data centers and other hardware; demand is growing alongside AI development.

IBKR‑US chief strategist Steve Sosnick says it’s not uncommon for companies to announce a split after a big price rally. Although SanDisk disclosed the plan at the end of October, management likely began planning earlier, when the stock was pulling back from an extraordinary high.
He believes management may want to boost appeal as the price falls, signaling strong performance that can support a split and making the stock feel more affordable to investors.
Lowering the per‑share price is a common rationale for splits, but with brokers now offering fractional‑share trading, the constraint of a high price has been lessened for investors.

Sosnick notes that splits can offer some benefits to options traders, such as improved liquidity. Standard equity options contracts represent 100 shares, and a lower per‑share price after a split reduces the dollar amount of the underlying position, making it easier for smaller investors to participate, though the split does not change the company’s intrinsic value for ordinary shareholders.

JD Group Holdings CEO John Dunfee also says a split may attract more retail attention but should not be the sole investment rationale. Investors should focus on the company’s earnings potential over the next one to two years and avoid mistaking the lower post‑split price for a cheaper valuation.

He stresses that real investment opportunities lie in anticipating earnings prospects ahead of the market, not in counting the extra shares. When the split hype fades, fundamentals and profitability will ultimately drive the stock price again.

paras:
台股盤前要聞

1.台股近期跌跌不休，19日再度重挫1768點，創收盤第7大跌點，失守4萬點、3萬9及年線大關。為維持證券市場秩序與穩定性，金管會宣布，自今(20)日起再祭出五大穩定股市措施，包括重啟「有條件禁空令」，當日收盤跌幅達3.5%以上，次一交易日不得低於前一交易日收盤價放空，並將每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限由3%大砍至1%，同時鼓勵金融業逢低買進績優股及上市櫃公司實施庫藏股，全力提振市場信心。

2.台股10月劇烈震盪，加權指數累計重挫2,729點，刷新史上「最慘10月」跌點紀錄，同時，外資賣超金額高達9,481億元，改寫史上最大賣超紀錄。受到股市重挫及自營、承銷業務轉虧拖累，全體證券商10月稅後純益降至75.2億元，較9月下滑112.61億元或59.96%；不過，受惠於上半年動能強勁，累計今年前10月稅後純益仍達2,087.74億元，較去年同期大幅成長1,210.89億元或138.1%。
3.晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)19日代子公司TSMC Partners公告，以每股83美元取得美國人工智慧新創公司Anthropic普通股602萬4096股，總交易金額達4億9999萬9968美元，持股比重約0.03%。此次交易價格與Anthropic首次公開發行定價相同，主要目的為長期股權投資。
4.台股19日在電金權值股走跌，加上傳產同步走弱，一度狂瀉1935.21點重摔至38259.7點，雖有國安基金進場救援，終場仍跌1768.02點或4.4%，創史上第七大跌點，收38426.89點，摜破年線，成交量8952.82億元。而外資今天提款243.12億元，連4賣，0050及多檔主動式ETF也再度成為減碼對象。

5.日月光投控(3711-TW)旗下台灣福雷電子1日於高雄仁武產業園區舉行新廠動土典禮，由日月光執行長吳田玉、高雄市市長陳其邁、經濟部產業園區管理局局長楊志清、高雄市議會議長康裕成等產官代表，並偕同日月光高雄廠一階主管共同出席見證。繼仁武建廠計畫推進後，台灣福雷電子再於投入新台幣2,489億元，預計於2028至2029年分期完成建置。未來K、J兩基地預計合計創造年營收約1,173億元及3,300個就業機會，擴大仁武「高階半導體測試服務產業園區」規模。

paras_en: The Taiwan market has been sliding recently, and on the 19th it plunged another 1,768 points, marking the seventh‑largest single‑day drop on record and breaking below the 40,000‑point, 39,000‑point and yearly moving‑average thresholds. To preserve market order and stability, the Financial Supervisory Commission announced that starting today (the 20th) it will implement five new stabilisation measures, including reinstating a “conditional short‑selling ban.” If a stock falls more than 3.5% at the close, short sales cannot be placed the next trading day at a price below the previous day’s close. The daily intraday borrowing‑to‑sell limit will be cut from 3% to 1%, and the commission will encourage financial institutions to buy quality stocks on dips and to conduct share buy‑backs, aiming to restore market confidence.

In October the Taiwan market experienced extreme volatility, with the weighted index falling a cumulative 2,729 points – the worst October drop in history. Foreign investors sold a record‑high NT$948.1 billion, setting a new all‑time net‑sell benchmark. The heavy market decline, together with losses in proprietary trading and underwriting, pushed the after‑tax net profit of all securities firms down to NT$7.52 billion for October, a drop of NT$11.261 billion or 59.96% from September. Nevertheless, buoyed by strong first‑half momentum, the cumulative net profit for the first ten months of the year remained NT$208.774 billion, up NT$121.089 billion or 138.1% year‑on‑year.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC, 2330‑TW) announced on the 19th, via its subsidiary TSMC Partners, that it has purchased 6,024,096 ordinary shares of U.S. AI start‑up Anthropic at US$83 per share, for a total transaction value of US$4,999,999,968, representing roughly 0.03% of Anthropic’s equity. The price matches Anthropic’s IPO pricing and the purchase is intended as a long‑term equity investment.

On the 19th the Taiwan market’s high‑tech and financial‑sector heavyweights fell, and traditional industries weakened simultaneously, causing a sharp plunge of 1,935.21 points to 38,259.7 points. Although the National Security Fund stepped in to provide support, the session still ended down 1,768.02 points or 4.4%, the seventh‑largest point drop ever, closing at 38,426.89 points and breaking below the yearly moving average, with a turnover of NT$895.282 billion. Foreign investors withdrew NT$24.312 billion that day, selling across four categories, and the 0050 index and several active ETFs again became targets for reduction.

Sunlight Group (3711‑TW) subsidiary Taiwan FoRe Electronics held a groundbreaking ceremony for a new plant in the Renwu Industrial Park, Kaohsiung, attended by Sunlight CEO Wu Tian‑yu, Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chi‑mai, Director‑General Yang Zhi‑qing of the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Park Administration, Kaohsiung City Council Speaker Kang Yu‑cheng, and senior managers from Sunlight’s Kaohsiung facility. Following the progress of the Renwu plant project, Taiwan FoRe will invest NT$248.9 billion, with construction slated for phased completion between 2028 and 2029. The K and J sites are expected to generate combined annual revenue of about NT$117.3 billion and create roughly 3,300 jobs, expanding the “high‑end semiconductor testing services industrial park” in Renwu.
The Taiwan market continues to tumble as the Financial Supervisory Commission rolls out the conditional short‑selling ban and four other stabilisation measures starting tomorrow.

October proves to be the worst on record for the Taiwan market, with all brokerage firms seeing monthly profits shrink by nearly 60%, though they still posted a cumulative profit of NT$208.7 billion for the first ten months.
TSMC spends close to US$500 million to acquire 6.02 million Anthropic shares, representing about 0.03% ownership.
Foreign investors withdraw another NT$24.3 billion, and the 0050 index and active ETFs suffer heavy sell‑offs.
Sunlight expands into the AI era, investing NT$248.9 billion in Kaohsiung’s Renwu district to enlarge the high‑end semiconductor testing cluster.
The Tatung‑Hua‑Ying case settles for RMB 768 million, potentially recouping close to RMB 10 billion in losses.
Huaxin’s Vietnam plant aims to complete construction and install equipment within a year to meet AI‑driven demand.
Guangyu expects its 2024 operations to improve, with Q1 shipments of optical‑communication products and AI server foundry services projected to contribute over NT$10 billion.
Evergreen Steel’s order backlog exceeds 208,000 tonnes, supported by AI and semiconductor fab construction demand, bolstering steel‑structure market sentiment.
Yujing Optical is optimistic about its partnership with U.S. firm 3M, expecting added operational momentum and increased capital expenditures.
Juxiang Outlook: EPS of NT$4.78 for the first three quarters surpasses the full‑year figure of last year, and Q4 operating intensity remains high.

items.title: 美國加強出口管制 金融時報：台積電、三星暫停部分對中晶片出貨
items.title_en: US Tightens Export Controls Financial Times: TSMC and Samsung Halt Some Chip Shipments to China
paras: 在美國為阻礙中國人工智慧（AI）發展而祭出新出口管制後，台積電(2330-TW) (TSM-US) 和三星電子已暫停向中國客戶提供部分晶片。
據倫敦《金融時報》19日（周四）報導，多位知情人士透露，這兩家晶片製造商最近幾天已通知中國客戶，在向美國商務部申請許可證期間將暫停特定處理器出貨。
對中國科技公司而言，這項措施是無疑是一大打擊，因為在記憶體晶片價格出現歷史性飆漲，以及中芯國際等本土供應商面臨產能限制後，這些企業已苦於應對零件短缺問題。
美國商務部工業暨安全局16日表示，使用美國技術製造先進晶片的製造商，必須申請許可證，才能銷售最終運往中國客戶的產品。
這項新規定堵住了中國晶片設計公司過去用來委託台積電和三星製造高性能晶片的管道。
雖然華府已限制向中國出口最先進處理器，但部分中國客戶仍能透過獨立封裝和測試公司下單購買高性能晶片。
兩位消息人士說，台積電和三星也通知消費性電子產品客戶暫停出貨。
工業暨安全局的新規定取消了先前用來證明晶片不在美國 AI 半導體限制範圍內的豁免條款，包括晶片是專為智慧型手機等非 AI 用途而設計的豁免。
一位聽取了情況簡報的律師表示，美方取消這項豁免，代表台積電和三星現在必須為採用先進製程的消費性晶片申請許可證。
台積電為小米(01810-HK) 、Oppo、Vivo 等中國智慧型手機製造商代工生產手機晶片。
一位業界人士認為，美國商務部很可能會核發消費性智慧型手機晶片許可證，但審批牛步恐怕會導致製造嚴重延遲。
paras_en: After the United States introduced new export controls to curb China’s artificial intelligence (AI) development, TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) and Samsung Electronics have halted shipments of certain chips to Chinese customers.

According to the Financial Times on Thursday the 19th, multiple insiders said the two chip makers have notified Chinese customers in recent days that they will pause shipments of specific processors while applications for licenses are pending with the U.S. Department of Commerce.

The move is a major blow to Chinese tech firms, which are already struggling with component shortages after memory chip prices surged to historic highs and domestic suppliers such as SMIC face capacity constraints.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security said on the 16th that manufacturers using U.S. technology to make advanced chips must obtain a license before selling finished products destined for Chinese customers.
The new rule blocks the channel Chinese chip designers previously used to contract TSMC and Samsung to produce high‑performance chips.
Although Washington has restricted exports of the most advanced processors to China, some Chinese customers can still order high‑performance chips through independent packaging and testing companies.
Two sources said TSMC and Samsung also told consumer‑electronics customers to suspend shipments.
The BIS rule removes the exemption that previously allowed chips to be classified as outside the U.S. AI semiconductor restrictions if they were designed for non‑AI uses such as smartphones.
A lawyer briefed on the situation said the U.S. removal of the exemption means TSMC and Samsung now have to apply for licenses for consumer chips that use advanced process nodes.
TSMC manufactures smartphone chips for Chinese makers such as Xiaomi (01810‑HK), Oppo and Vivo.
An industry insider believes the Commerce Department is likely to grant licenses for consumer‑grade smartphone chips, but a slow approval process could cause serious manufacturing delays.

items.title: 保障「床前孝子」！政院拍板民法繼承特別貢獻條款：照顧長輩可多拿遺產
items.title_en: Protecting the "Filial Son at the Bedside"! Executive Yuan Approves Special Contribution Clause in Civil Code Inheritance: More Estate for Those Who Care for Elders
paras: 遺產分配規定將迎來重大變革，行政院會今 (19) 日通過法務部擬具的民法繼承編及施行法部分條文修正草案，將送請立法院審議。本次修法最大亮點，是當配偶與兄弟姊妹共同繼承時，配偶應繼分提高至三分之二，並新增繼承人特別貢獻條款，讓生前照顧長輩或協助家業的子女在分遺產時能獲得實質回饋，全面平衡家族成員權益。
行政院長卓榮泰在會中指出，今 (2026) 年 8 月 17 日修正公布的民法第 1223 條，雖然刪除了兄弟姊妹特留分規定，但當時並未同步制定其他配套措施。如果長輩生前未預先立下遺囑或指定分配比例，現行遺產分割方式往往與現代家庭生活型態及社會觀念有所落差。
卓榮泰進一步說明，為了徹底解決實務上的遺產分配爭議，行政院這次特別提出完整的配套修法。內容不僅重新調整遺產酌給請求權的規範，更首度增訂繼承人特別貢獻等重要規定，希望藉此平衡保障生存配偶與兄弟姊妹的合法權益。卓榮泰也指示法務部，法案送交立法院後要積極與朝野各黨團溝通，期盼能儘速完成三讀程序。
在這次民法繼承編修正草案中，最受民眾關注的莫過於配偶遺產比例的調升。未來如果被繼承人沒有子女，由配偶與被繼承人的兄弟姊妹共同繼承遺產時，配偶的應繼分將從原本的一半提高到遺產的三分之二，而兄弟姊妹的應繼分則相應調整為三分之一，大幅強化對另一半的生活保障。
針對過去常引發爭執的照顧者權益，新增「特別貢獻條款」。未來繼承人之中，如果有人曾對被繼承人的事業提供勞務或金錢給付、親自療養看護，或透過其他方式協助維持及增加財產，在計算遺產時可先扣除這筆特別貢獻的價額，並於分割遺產時直接加進該名繼承人的應繼分中，讓付出較多的人不再吃虧。
在遺囑限制與遺產請求權方面，草案也做出更貼近現代社會的調整。立遺囑禁止遺產分割的期限統一設定為 5 年，避免遺產長期遭到凍結無法運用。同時也重新釐清得請求酌給遺產的請求權人與對象，並明確增訂酌給遺產的額度、計算方法及請求時效。
此外，為了避免遺產分割程序無限期拖延，草案增訂明確規範遺產分割適用生前贈與歸扣及特別貢獻規定的請求期限，以及例外不受此期間限制的特殊情形。這項設計能促使所有繼承人儘早出面處理遺產事宜，讓複雜的家族財產關係早日塵埃落定。
至於配套的民法繼承編施行法修正草案，則針對新舊法規的銜接訂出明確過渡期。本次新法施行前就已經生效的禁止分割遺囑，原則上雖然適用舊法，但如果從新法施行日起算，其殘餘的禁止分割期間超過 5 年，一律直接縮短為 5 年，確保所有遺產都能在合理時間內完成分配。
paras_en: The rules for estate distribution are set for a major overhaul, as the Executive Yuan today (the 19th) passed a draft amendment to parts of the Civil Code inheritance chapter and its implementing law prepared by the Ministry of Justice, which will be sent to the Legislative Yuan for review. The biggest highlight of the amendment is that when a spouse and siblings inherit together, the spouse's share will be raised to two‑thirds, and a special contribution clause for heirs is added, allowing children who cared for their parents or helped the family business to receive tangible compensation in the estate division, fully balancing family members' rights.

Executive Yuan President Cho Jung‑tai noted that the amendment to Article 1223 of the Civil Code, published on August 17, 2026, removed the reserved share for siblings but did not introduce accompanying measures at the time. If elders did not leave a will or specify a distribution ratio, the current method of dividing estates often clashes with modern family lifestyles and social values.

Cho explained that to thoroughly resolve practical inheritance disputes, the Executive Yuan is proposing a complete set of complementary amendments. The changes not only revise the rules on claims for discretionary portions of the estate, but also for the first time add important provisions on heirs' special contributions, aiming to balance and protect the legitimate rights of surviving spouses and siblings. He also instructed the Ministry of Justice to actively communicate with all party caucuses after the bill is submitted to the Legislative Yuan, hoping to complete the three‑reading process swiftly.

In this draft amendment to the inheritance chapter, the most public‑focused change is the increase in the spouse’s estate share. In the future, if the decedent has no children and the estate is inherited jointly by the spouse and the decedent’s siblings, the spouse’s share will rise from the current half to two‑thirds of the estate, while the siblings’ share will be adjusted to one‑third, greatly strengthening the surviving partner’s livelihood protection.

Addressing the long‑standing disputes over caregivers’ rights, a new “special contribution clause” is introduced. In the future, among the heirs, anyone who has provided labor or monetary support to the decedent’s business, personally cared for the decedent, or otherwise helped preserve or increase the assets may have the value of that contribution deducted first and then added directly to that heir’s share, ensuring that those who contributed more are not disadvantaged.

Regarding will restrictions and claims on the estate, the draft also makes adjustments more in line with modern society. The prohibition period for a will that blocks estate division is uniformly set at five years to prevent assets from being frozen indefinitely. It also clarifies the parties entitled to claim discretionary portions, and explicitly defines the amount, calculation method, and limitation period for such claims.

Furthermore, to prevent endless delays in estate division, the draft adds clear rules on the time limit for invoking the pre‑gift deduction and special contribution provisions, as well as exceptions that are not subject to this limit. This design encourages all heirs to address estate matters promptly, allowing complex family wealth relationships to be settled sooner.

As for the accompanying amendment to the implementing law of the inheritance chapter, it sets a clear transition period for linking the old and new statutes. Although the prohibition‑of‑division clause that took effect before the new law generally applies the old law, if the remaining prohibition period exceeds five years from the new law’s effective date, it will be shortened to five years, ensuring all estates are distributed within a reasonable timeframe.

items.title: 海外下單也要查！台積電傳收緊對中代工 中國AI晶片再卡關
items.title_en: Even Overseas Orders Must Be Scrutinized! TSMC Tightens Restrictions on Chinese Foundry Clients, Further Hindering China’s AI Chip Efforts
paras: 據《路透》周四(19日)引述兩名知情人士報導，台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)正收緊對中國晶片設計業者的限制，暫停部分先前獲准的先進製程訂單。受影響客戶若未取得美國出口許可，通常將只能使用較舊製程，可能進一步壓縮中國業者打造高效能AI晶片的管道。
知情人士表示，台積電已指示，受影響的16奈米及更先進製程訂單，須暫停執行，除非客戶取得美國出口許可。根據兩人看過的台積電指引，中國設計業者通常將被限制使用28奈米與40奈米製程，且晶片不得使用高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，也不能需要先進封裝。
這項調整可能使中國發展國產AI處理器、降低對輝達(NVDA-US)晶片依賴的努力，面臨更多阻力。

美國取消原有驗證管道 先進晶片須取得出口許可

台積電收緊限制，源於美國商務部周四生效的新規。新規取消一項既有合規途徑，過去部分中國晶片設計業者可透過這項機制，取得先進製造服務，無須逐案申請出口許可。
先前，台積電可檢查部分中國客戶晶片設計的運算能力與其他技術特性，判斷是否未達美國出口管制門檻。
新規生效後，台積電無法再對受影響中國客戶採用這套驗證程序。相關先進晶片將被推定屬於美國管制範圍，除非符合例外條件，否則必須取得出口許可。
《金融時報》周四率先報導，台積電與南韓三星電子(005930-KS)已因應新限制，暫停向部分中國客戶出貨晶片。
目前多數領先AI晶片採用7奈米或更先進製程，以提升效能與能源效率；HBM協助處理AI應用所需的龐大資料量，先進封裝則將晶片與記憶體整合，進一步提高運算能力。

中國自研AI晶片受衝擊 海外子公司下單也納入審查

這些措施可能特別影響開發輝達替代產品的中國業者，包括獨立晶片設計公司，以及投入自研晶片的科技巨頭。
美國政府公布的獲核准晶片設計業者名單，包含輝達、超微(AMD-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)，以及台灣的聯發科(2454-TW)、瑞昱(2379-TW)，但未納入任何中國業者。
另一名直接知情人士透露，部分中國AI晶片設計公司在周四以前，仍能使用台積電7奈米製程。不過，《路透》無法獨立確認這些晶片是透過何種安排進行生產。
知情人士指出，台積電最新指引也要求，更嚴格檢查客戶的營運據點、母公司、主要股東、封裝服務商與運輸路線。
審查範圍同樣涵蓋透過海外子公司或中間業者提出的訂單，包括設於台灣、美國、歐洲、日本與東南亞的實體，顯示透過境外架構下單，也將面臨更深入查核。
paras_en: According to Reuters on Thursday (the 19th), citing two insiders, TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) is tightening its restrictions on Chinese chip designers by suspending some previously approved advanced‑process orders. Affected customers who have not obtained U.S. export licences will generally have to use older processes, which could further narrow the channel for Chinese firms to produce high‑performance AI chips.

Insiders said TSMC has instructed that affected 16‑nm and more advanced process orders must be put on hold unless the customer secures a U.S. export licence. Based on the TSMC guidelines seen by the two sources, Chinese designers are typically barred from using 28‑nm and 40‑nm processes, and their chips may not employ high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) or require advanced packaging.
This adjustment could make China’s push to develop domestic AI processors and reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA‑US) chips face greater resistance.

The tightening stems from a new rule that took effect on Thursday at the U.S. Commerce Department. The rule eliminates an existing compliance pathway that previously allowed some Chinese chip designers to obtain advanced manufacturing services without filing individual export licence applications.

Previously, TSMC could review the computational capability and other technical characteristics of certain Chinese customers’ chip designs to determine whether they fell below U.S. export‑control thresholds.

After the new rule took effect, TSMC can no longer use that verification procedure for the affected Chinese customers. The related advanced chips will be presumed subject to U.S. controls and, unless an exception applies, will require an export licence.
The Financial Times reported on Thursday that TSMC and South Korea’s Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS) have already halted shipments of chips to some Chinese customers in response to the new limits.

Most leading AI chips today use 7‑nm or more advanced processes to boost performance and energy efficiency; HBM helps handle the massive data volumes required by AI workloads, and advanced packaging integrates chips with memory to further raise compute capability.
The measures could especially impact Chinese firms developing Nvidia alternatives, including independent chip designers and tech giants that are investing in their own chips.

The U.S. government’s approved list of chip designers includes Nvidia, AMD (AMD‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US), as well as Taiwan’s MediaTek (2454‑TW) and Realtek (2379‑TW), but no Chinese companies are on the list.
Another insider said that some Chinese AI chip designers were still able to use TSMC’s 7‑nm process before Thursday, though Reuters could not independently verify how those chips were produced.
The insider added that TSMC’s latest guidelines also call for stricter checks of customers’ operating locations, parent companies, major shareholders, packaging service providers and shipping routes.

The scope of review also covers orders placed through overseas subsidiaries or intermediaries, including entities located in Taiwan, the United States, Europe, Japan and Southeast Asia, indicating that orders routed through foreign structures will also face deeper scrutiny.

items.title: 美國晶片禁令今正式生效！台積電緊急喊停中國16奈米先進製程訂單，AI晶片設計完成也恐無廠可代工
items.title_en: U.S. Chip Ban Takes Effect Today! TSMC Urgently Halts Chinese 16nm Advanced Process Orders; Completed AI Chip Designs May Lack Foundry Options
paras: 2026年11月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國最新晶片出口管制規定今日正式生效，中國晶片設計業者取得海外先進製程產能的難度進一步升高。根據路透社報導，台積電(2330-TW)已要求暫停部分中國客戶原本可以承作的晶片訂單，涉及16奈米及更先進製程。受影響客戶必須先取得美國政府出口許可，相關訂單才能繼續執行，意味中國業者即使已完成晶片設計，也未必能順利委託海外晶圓代工廠生產。
這次新規最關鍵的變化，在於美國直接收緊晶圓代工廠自行判斷訂單是否符合出口管制規定的空間。
過去，台積電可以透過查核客戶晶片的運算能力及其他技術規格，確認產品是否落入美國出口管制範圍。只要符合相關條件，部分中國客戶仍有機會使用先進製程生產晶片。
然而，新規生效後，符合特定條件的先進晶片將被推定屬於出口管制對象，除非符合美方核准的例外條件，否則必須取得出口許可。換言之，過去能夠透過技術規格審查放行的訂單，如今可能必須先經過美國政府核准，晶片能否生產不再單純取決於技術條件。
根據台積電的接單指引，受影響的中國客戶原則上仍可使用28奈米、40奈米等成熟製程，但前提是相關晶片不使用高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，也不需要搭配先進封裝技術。
不過，成熟製程並不代表能夠直接替代先進製程。尤其對積極開發輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)替代產品的中國AI晶片業者而言，這項限制可能直接影響產品設計與量產計畫。
目前主流高階AI加速晶片多採用7奈米或更先進製程，並結合HBM與先進封裝技術，以提升運算效能、記憶體頻寬及能源使用效率。若被迫轉向28奈米或40奈米製程，原有晶片架構往往需要大幅重新設計，也難以維持相同的效能與功耗表現。
因此，新規對中國AI晶片產業的影響，不只是增加出口許可申請程序，更可能讓部分已完成設計的高階AI晶片面臨無法順利投產的問題。
另一方面，台積電也將擴大客戶背景審查範圍，包括晶片設計公司的實際營運所在地、母公司、主要股東，以及後續負責封裝的業者。即使中國客戶透過海外子公司、第三地企業或中間商下單，仍可能被納入查核。
這代表中國晶片設計公司即使將訂單轉由海外關係企業承接，也不一定能避開美國出口管制。晶圓代工廠除了確認晶片規格，還必須進一步追查訂單背後的實際客戶、企業控制關係及供應鏈安排。

paras_en: November 19, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – The United States’ latest chip export control rules took effect today, further raising the difficulty for Chinese chip designers to secure overseas advanced‑process capacity. Reuters reported that TSMC (2330‑TW) has asked to suspend certain chip orders from Chinese customers that could previously be manufactured, covering the 16‑nm node and more advanced processes. Affected customers must first obtain a U.S. export licence before the orders can proceed, meaning that even if Chinese firms have finished chip designs, they may still be unable to contract overseas wafer fabs for production.
The key change in the new regulation is that the United States now directly narrows the space for wafer foundries to independently judge whether an order falls under export controls.

Previously, TSMC could review a customer’s chip computational capability and other technical specifications to determine whether the product was subject to U.S. export controls. If the criteria were met, some Chinese customers could still use advanced processes to produce chips.

Under the new rules, advanced chips that meet certain criteria are presumed to be export‑controlled items; unless they qualify for a U.S.‑approved exemption, an export licence is required. In other words, orders that were once cleared through technical‑spec reviews now may need prior U.S. government approval, and production is no longer decided solely on technical grounds.

According to TSMC’s order‑taking guidelines, affected Chinese customers can still use mature nodes such as 28 nm and 40 nm, provided the chips do not employ high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and do not require advanced packaging technologies.

However, mature nodes do not simply replace advanced processes. For Chinese AI chip makers aggressively developing NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) alternatives, this restriction could directly impact product design and mass‑production plans.

Most mainstream high‑end AI accelerators today use 7‑nm or more advanced processes, combined with HBM and advanced packaging to boost compute performance, memory bandwidth and energy efficiency. Being forced to shift to 28 nm or 40 nm would typically require a major redesign of the chip architecture and would struggle to maintain the same performance and power characteristics.

Thus, the new rules affect China’s AI chip industry not only by adding export‑licence procedures but also by potentially leaving some already‑designed high‑end AI chips unable to enter production smoothly.

On the other hand, TSMC will broaden its customer background checks to include the actual operating location of the chip design company, its parent, major shareholders, and the downstream packaging providers. Even if Chinese customers place orders through overseas subsidiaries, third‑party entities or intermediaries, they may still be subject to scrutiny.

This means that Chinese chip design firms cannot necessarily evade U.S. export controls by routing orders through overseas related entities. Foundries must not only verify chip specifications but also trace the real end‑customer, corporate control relationships and supply‑chain arrangements behind each order.

items.title: 長榮鋼在手訂單逾20.8萬噸 AI、半導體廠房需求支撐鋼構景氣
items.title_en: Chang Rong Steel's Order Book Exceeds 208,000 Tons, AI and Semiconductor Plant Demand Supports Steel Structure Market
paras: 鋼構廠長榮鋼(2211-TW)今(19)日召開法說，受惠AI及半導體產業持續擴廠，加上捷運聯合開發、都市更新及物流廠房等建案推動，鋼構市場景氣維持穩定。
截至2026年9月底，在手訂單達20.84萬噸，其中廠房訂單4.25萬2579噸，占比20%；大樓訂單16,58萬噸，占比80%，另有橋樑訂單28噸。截至今年9月新接訂單來看，合計5.8萬噸，其中廠房訂單2.72萬噸，占比47%，大樓訂單3.07萬噸，占比53%。
展望鋼構市場，長榮鋼指出，AI及半導體產業持續擴廠，捷運聯合開發、都更案及物流廠房持續推動，有助支撐鋼構市場需求；不過，受到政府房市政策及景氣變動影響，住宅建案推案量持續放緩，中長期鋼構市場需求是否受到影響，仍須持續觀察。
在成本及供應鏈管理方面，長榮鋼表示，材料採購須留意原物料價格上漲影響，將持續推動長單及與客戶採取鋼材價格浮動機制，以降低價格波動風險，同時加強供應商聯繫與管理，確保材料供應及施工人力，以符合客戶工期要求。
轉投資事業方面，欣榮企業自2024年9月完成整改後，營運已恢復正常，焚化爐運轉率及廢棄物處理效能均提升，未來將持續進行設備維護及汰舊換新，維持穩定處理量能。水美工程則將穩定既有客戶合作、拓展適合處理的廢棄物來源，並推動蒸氣回收及能源利用，提升熱能回收效率。
榮鼎綠能方面，熱處理單元將優先處理桃園市政府交付的家戶垃圾，並依剩餘處理量能調整自收廢棄物進廠量，維持雙爐穩定運轉；厭氧消化單元則配合市府交付量穩定處理，維持售電收益。
paras_en: Steel structure builder Chang Rong Steel (2211-TW) held a briefing today (19th). Benefiting from continued expansion of AI and semiconductor industries, as well as joint metro developments, urban renewal projects, and logistics facilities, the steel structure market remains stable.

As of the end of September 2026, the order book reached 208,400 tons, including 42,579 tons of plant orders (20% of the total) and 165,800 tons of building orders (80%). There are also 28 tons of bridge orders. New orders received through September this year total 58,000 tons, with plant orders at 27,200 tons (47%) and building orders at 30,700 tons (53%).

Looking ahead, Chang Rong Steel notes that ongoing expansion in AI and semiconductor sectors, continued joint metro projects, urban renewal cases, and logistics facilities will help sustain demand for steel structures. However, government housing policies and economic fluctuations have slowed the launch of residential projects, so the medium- to long-term impact on steel structure demand requires close monitoring.

Regarding cost and supply‑chain management, the company says material procurement must watch raw‑material price hikes. It will keep promoting long‑term contracts and adopt price‑adjustment mechanisms with customers to reduce price‑volatility risk, while strengthening supplier communication and management to ensure material supply and labor for construction meet client schedule requirements.

In its investment businesses, Xin Rong Enterprise has returned to normal operations after completing remediation in September 2024, with higher incinerator utilization and improved waste‑treatment performance. It will continue equipment maintenance and replacement to keep stable processing capacity. Shui Mei Engineering will maintain existing customer collaborations, expand suitable waste sources, and promote steam recovery and energy utilization to boost thermal‑energy recovery efficiency.

For Rong Ding Green Energy, the heat‑treatment unit will prioritize processing household waste assigned by the Taoyuan City Government and will adjust the intake of self‑collected waste based on remaining capacity to keep both furnaces running smoothly. The anaerobic digestion unit will handle the city‑assigned volume steadily, maintaining electricity‑sale revenue.

items.title: 矽瑪(3511)無人機、機器人產品陸續出貨第四季聚焦改善產品組合與成本
items.title_en: Silma (3511) Drone and Robot Products Ship Gradually; Q4 Focuses on Improving Product Mix and Costs
paras: 2026年11月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 矽瑪(3511-TW)表示，無人機與人形機器人相關產品今年陸續出貨，部分已進入量產；醫療線束則隨新產品及新專案導入，業務明顯成長。公司第三季營收與毛利率較去年同期改善，但本業仍虧損，第四季將持續調整產品組合，並降低材料與製造成本。
矽瑪第三季營收5.24億元，季增13%、年增27%；毛利率13.4%，較去年同期提高3.8個百分點。營業虧損2,300萬元，較去年同期縮小51%，每股虧損0.28元。公司表示，無人機、醫療及台灣電子代工客戶持續貢獻營收，既有專案需求延續。
矽瑪提供無人機及機器人使用的線材與線束。無人機運作時會面臨振動及安裝空間有限等條件，相關線束需要兼顧輕量化、耐磨與電磁屏蔽；機器人線材則著重反覆彎折、扭轉下的耐用性，用於傳輸電力、控制訊號及資料。
醫療業務方面，總經理胡若堯表示，今年隨客戶合作深化，以及新產品、新專案導入，醫療線束業務已有明顯成長，公司將持續擴大相關應用。
除線材與連接器外，矽瑪也結合子公司同星的表面黏著技術及電路板組裝能力，開始為美國客戶提供模組組裝服務。供應方面，公司表示目前未見缺料，所掌握的終端客戶庫存水位也不高，主要依既有訂單與客戶需求安排備料。
公司第四季將深化與電子代工客戶的合作，參與新產品開發及設計導入，同時調整售價與成本，改善營運表現。

paras_en: November 19, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Silma (3511‑TW) said its drone and humanoid robot‑related products have been shipped throughout the year, with some already in mass production; the medical wiring line has grown markedly as new products and projects are introduced. The company’s Q3 revenue and gross margin improved versus the same period last year, but the core business remains loss‑making. In Q4 it will continue to adjust the product mix and cut material and manufacturing costs.

Silma posted Q3 revenue of NT$524 million, up 13% sequentially and 27% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 13.4%, a 3.8‑percentage‑point increase from last year’s same quarter. Operating loss was NT$23 million, 51% lower than a year ago, equating to a loss of NT$0.28 per share. The company said drones, medical, and Taiwanese electronics foundry customers continued to contribute revenue, and existing project demand persisted.

Silma supplies wires and harnesses used in drones and robots. Drone harnesses must cope with vibration and limited installation space, requiring lightweight, wear‑resistant and electromagnetic‑shielded designs; robot wiring emphasizes durability under repeated bending and twisting, carrying power, control signals and data.

Regarding the medical business, General Manager Hu Ruo‑yao said that deeper collaboration with customers this year, together with new products and projects, has led to clear growth in medical harness sales, and the company will keep expanding related applications.

In addition to wires and connectors, Silma has combined its subsidiary Tongxing’s surface‑adhesion technology and PCB assembly capability to start offering module‑assembly services to U.S. customers. On the supply side, the company said it has not seen material shortages, and end‑customer inventory levels are low, so it plans material stocking based on existing orders and customer demand.

In Q4 the company will deepen cooperation with electronics foundry customers, participate in new product development and design integration, and simultaneously adjust pricing and costs to improve operating performance.
